sample_unit: deceased organ donor cases (declared dead by neurological criteria)

links.outcome: Time from first apnoea test to organ retrieval before versus after AI protocol implementation
links.effect: Retrieval time rose from 1587 (IQR 1328-1779) min pre-AI to 1660 (IQR 1556-1959) min post-AI (p=0.04). Transfer to the operating room after legal verification rose from 125 to 384 min (p=0.002).
links.quote: While the AI-based protocol enhanced data verification and transparency, it also introduced unanticipated procedural delays.

unlisted_practices: AI-based automated data verification and transparency application for organ procurement after brain death
Fishbone root-cause analysis of delay factors in organ retrieval

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world operational impact of deploying an AI-based organ procurement and data verification application on clinical workflow timelines.
